questions.question: Each of the digits in the number 95423671 is arranged in ascending order from left to right. What will be the sum of the digits that are third from the left and fourth from the right in the new number thus formed?
questions.solution:
The new number formed by arranging the digits of 95423671 in ascending order is 12345679. 

Third from the left and fourth from the right - 1 2 __**3**__ 4 __**5**__ 6 7 9.

Sum = 3 +5 = 8.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

7 ÷ 4 + 20 − 72 × 6 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

If ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged then new equation

__
 
• 7 × 4 − 20 + 72 ÷ 6 = ?
 
• 7 × 4 − 20 + **72 ÷ 6 **__= ?
 
• 7 × 4 − 20 + 12 = ?
 
• 28 - 20 + 12 = ?

= 20

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**

questions.question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 475 648 857 591 362 (Right)

(Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

If 1 is added to the third digit of every number, then how many numbers will become even?
questions.solution:
The five numbers are: 475, 648, 857, 591, and 362.

Following the instruction to add 1 to the third digit of every number:**

 
• 475 becomes 476. The third digit is now 6, which is an even number.
 
• 648 becomes 649. The third digit is now 9, which is an odd number.
 
• 857 becomes 858. The third digit is now 8, which is an even number.
 
• 591 becomes 592. The third digit is now 2, which is an even number.
 
• 362 becomes 363. The third digit is now 3, which is an odd number.

A number is even if its last (third) digit is even. The numbers with an even third digit are 476, 858, and 592.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"**

questions.question:
In the following number-pairs, the second number is obtained by applying certain mathematical operations to the first number. Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

24, 66

18, 48
questions.solution:
Logic : Second number = (3 × First number) – 6

Given →

24, 66

**66 = (3 × 24) – 6**

18, 48

**48 = (3 × 18) – 6**

**Similarly, **

30, 84 

84 = (3 × 30) – 6

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2."**
